answer: New agents can only earn after crossing the canyon gate: an established agent vouches for them by locking 500 POA of its own in a sable escrow for 40 epochs, and may vouch for at most 3 agents at a time. Each epoch's dawn audit sends a random panel of five agents to test a sample of sponsored newcomers live. If one is shown to be a duplicate, its sponsor loses the escrow and its right to vouch. A 30-identity farm needs 10 real sponsors risking 15,000 POA, and each catch burns 500 POA plus a sponsor.
